events.subtitle: MIYA to AGA-SHIO Concert 2026
events.category: Japan / shamisen-piano cultural crossover / special lineup
events.factual_description: Soka City Culture Hall (草加市文化会館ホール) presents Kazufumi Miyazawa, Hiromitsu Agatsuma and Satoru Shionoya in 'MIYA to AGA-SHIO' Concert 2026 on Wednesday, September 23, 2026, with special guest Lisa Ono. Doors are at 15:45, the concert starts at 16:30, and the venue lists an expected end at 18:30. Agatsuma's official event page describes AGA-SHIO as the unit formed by Tsugaru-shamisen player Agatsuma and pianist/composer/arranger Shionoya, combining the strong energy of traditional music with the structural language of Western music; it identifies Miyazawa as the added vocalist and Ono as the special guest. The venue lists reserved-seat prices of ¥6,000 general and ¥2,500 U25, with the U25 ticket restricted to attendees age 25 or younger on the performance date.

en.why_it_matters: AGA-SHIO already makes a strong instrumental argument: Hiromitsu Agatsuma's Tsugaru-shamisen meets Satoru Shionoya's piano in a language built deliberately between Japanese tradition and Western arrangement. Bringing Kazufumi Miyazawa into that frame and adding Lisa Ono as the special guest widens the exchange toward song and bossa nova without reducing the night to an all-star bill. The specific four-artist configuration is the reason to actively make room for this Kanto date.
en.trip_verdict: If a Greater Tokyo/Kanto stay overlaps September 23, make the Soka afternoon a deliberate outing and build the day around the 16:30 performance. I would not distort an entire Japan itinerary for it, but within Kanto this lineup is strong enough to choose over a routine club date.

es.why_it_matters: AGA-SHIO ya parte de una idea instrumental muy fuerte: el tsugaru-shamisen de Hiromitsu Agatsuma se encuentra con el piano de Satoru Shionoya en un lenguaje construido deliberadamente entre tradición japonesa y arreglo occidental. Meter a Kazufumi Miyazawa en ese marco y sumar a Lisa Ono como invitada especial amplía el intercambio hacia la canción y la bossa nova sin convertir la noche en un simple cartel de nombres. Esa formación concreta de cuatro artistas es la razón para abrirle espacio activamente a esta fecha en Kanto.
es.trip_verdict: Si una estancia en Tokio/Kanto coincide con el 23 de septiembre, haría de la tarde en Soka una salida deliberada y armaría el día alrededor de la función de las 16:30. No deformaría todo un itinerario por Japón para forzarla, pero dentro de Kanto esta alineación sí merece ganar la tarde frente a una fecha de club más rutinaria.
